summary: One app to run and manage many coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and more) in parallel, on desktop, phone, web or CLI.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Paseo is an open-source development environment for working with AI coding agents. A local server (the daemon) manages agents like Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode, and desktop, mobile, web and CLI clients connect to it. You can run many agents at once, each in its own git worktree, review their diffs, open pull requests, use terminals and a built-in browser, and even control it by voice.
sixtySeconds.problem: Juggling several coding agents across terminals and machines is messy. Paseo puts them in one interface you can reach from any device.
whoFor: Developers using several AI coding agents
People who want to check on agents from their phone
Teams running agents on a remote workstation
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to orchestrate multiple agent CLIs side by side, self-hosted, without telemetry or forced login.
requirements: At least one agent CLI installed and signed in, such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or OpenCode

overview: Install and sign in to at least one supported agent CLI first.
Download the desktop app from paseo.sh/download or GitHub releases; opening it starts the daemon automatically.
On a server, install the CLI with npm and run paseo, or use the Docker image. It is Apache-2.0 licensed.

features.title: Multi-provider
features.body: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode and more.

features.title: Full workflow
features.body: Edit, diff, terminals, pull requests, browser.

features.title: Privacy
features.body: No telemetry; optional end-to-end encrypted relay.

limitations: Needs your own agent CLIs and their subscriptions
Docker image must be extended with the agent CLIs you use

useCases.title: Parallel features
useCases.body: Run agents on separate branches at once.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Paseo's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.
prerequisites: A supported agent CLI with credentials

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Get the app from paseo.sh/download or the GitHub releases page.

steps.title: Open it
steps.body: The daemon starts automatically. To pair your phone, open Settings, your host, Pair Device.

steps.title: Start the daemon
steps.body: It asks whether to enable the encrypted relay for device pairing; if you decline, connect over TCP, Tailscale or a VPN.

steps.title: Run the daemon and web UI
steps.body: Change the password, then open http://localhost:6767. Extend the image with the agent CLIs you use.

firstRun.title: Start an agent
firstRun.body: Open the desktop app and start a task with an agent you have installed.

tutorial.title: Run agents from the CLI
setup: An agent CLI such as Claude Code or Codex signed in

steps.title: Start a task
steps.body: paseo run with --provider and a task description; add --worktree to run it on its own branch.

steps.title: Follow and steer
steps.body: paseo attach <id> streams live output; paseo send <id> "also add tests" gives a follow-up.

tutorial.expected: Agents working in parallel that you can watch and message.
nextSteps: Run on a remote host with --host
